grading.sourceOfTruth: Native receipts, independent state/oracles and blind human review; never the product's completed flag alone.
grading.denominator: Every planned variant/case/repeat including timeouts, provider failures and not-run cases.
grading.missing: Unknown; never zero cost or verified success.
grading.nudges: Corrective follow-ups separate from planned steering, necessary clarification and approval.
grading.admission: All six families, two distinct cases per family, no candidate failures or critical regressions, complete metrics and human QA; at most manual pilot review, never automatic production release.
grading.limits: 24 pilot runs cannot prove long-term reliability; a separately held-out human task set is still required.
